name: io.github.ap311036/timetree-mcp
title: TimeTree MCP
description: TimeTree MCP server for calendar search, events, memos, comments, and change monitoring. Local stdio; confirmation-gated writes.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: TimeTree account email. Set with TIMETREE_PASSWORD or TIMETREE_PASSWORD_FILE; omit all three to use a complete macOS Keychain pair. Partial sources are rejected.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: TimeTree account password paired with TIMETREE_EMAIL. Prefer macOS Keychain or a private password file; do not pass credentials as MCP tool arguments.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a password file with restricted permissions, preferably mode 600.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional direct HTTPS origin override. Defaults to https://timetreeapp.com; custom origins must use HTTPS, with no credentials, path, query, or fragment. Proxy environments are rejected.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP User-Agent override for the direct HTTPS transport.

environmentVariables.name: TIMETREE_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute private directory for the durable occurrence journal. Keep a stable shared location for local processes; never delete or change it to retry uncertain writes.
